info.description: Generated strictly from source code (controllers, DTOs, validation annotations, service-layer response construction) as of this session — not from prior Postman collections, README, or Swagger. Every endpoint's request/response shapes, status codes, and header behavior were confirmed by direct source reads and, for the responseType/observability features, live curl verification against a running instance. Global observability headers (X-Request-Id, X-API-Version, X-Timestamp) are set on EVERY response by RequestCorrelationFilter and asserted in each request's test script.

item.name: Convert URL to Base64 dynamic - CONFIRMED DIVERGENT security failure

request.description: CONFIRMED SOURCE-CODE DIVERGENCE (verified by direct read of PdfService.fetchAndConvertToBase64Dynamic): urlAllowlistValidator.validate(req.getUrl()) is called BEFORE the method's own try block starts, and PdfFetchController.convertToBase64Dynamic has no try/catch at all around this call. The IllegalArgumentException propagates fully uncaught, producing Spring Boot's generic default error body — NOT this endpoint's normal PdfResponse{status:'FAILED:...'} shape used by every other failure path in this codebase. Per instruction to treat source code as ground truth over expected/documented behavior, this is intentionally captured as its own example rather than assumed to match the sibling /convert/base64 endpoint.
